As of December 31, 2006, 8,640,686 stock options remain available for grant under the Employee Plans, which can also 
be used for awards to nonemployee directors. 
 
 
The Employee Plans primarily provide for the grant of options (both non-qualified options and incentive stock options 
as defined in each respective plan), stock appreciation rights and restricted stock to key employees of the Company or its 
subsidiaries (as determined by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors) for periods not exceeding ten years.  
Options granted under the Employee Plans vest incrementally in periods ranging from six months to four years.  Under the 
Director Plan, nonemployee directors are entitled to an annual distribution of 3,600 shares of common stock and options to 
purchase an additional 7,000 shares.  All options granted under the Director Plan are non-qualified, vest immediately and are 
exercisable on the date of grant.  Options granted under the Director Plan are exercisable for ten years from the grant date.
